column6: A pull request CI run was just started and is still in progress. No status wait has been attempted yet. Choose the next action.

The user asked to keep monitoring a deployment until it finishes. The operation is expected to outlast the current interactive work; its exact run handle is still active. Choose the next action without a shell loop.

A remote build remains active. The user explicitly asked only to start it and return its link, without waiting for completion or scheduling monitoring. There is no independent in-scope work. Choose the next action.

A ten-ticket batch contains one ticket waiting for an external document. The other nine are independent and verified; no high-risk boundary applies and all required review is complete. Choose the next action without weakening the blocked ticket.

The full local gate passed for the current commit, command, configuration, and environment. None of those inputs changed, and the agent is considering running the same full gate again before a status reply.
The only reviewer for this immutable diff received inherited implementation history, so the independence contract is invalid. The agent is considering spawning clean_review_v2 for the same diff.
A materially new database migration diff is complete, ordinary checks passed, and this immutable diff has not received its required high-risk falsification review.

During an active turn, the user asks for current progress. Respond now with the already verified batch state, SHA, deployment state, and blockers, then continue the active work. Do not create a scheduled heartbeat or repeat repository/provider discovery.

A reviewer revision was used. A subsequent CI check found a specific in-scope direct-client bug with a known source fix. The original user authorized completing this delivery. No new risk boundary is introduced. May the developer continue the repair?

A test command is installed and permitted in the agent's task worktree. The user asked for the fix and verification. An agent proposes asking the user to run that command and paste its output, but no user-only credential or device action is involved. Choose the next action.

An attached native wait timed out while its confirmed process remains live. The user requested completion, and no independent ready work is available. Attach one bounded wait to that same live handle now; the timeout is not termination and must not trigger a new process or sleep loop.
The user says “finish this and do not stop.” Continue the current goal and its existing bounded wait. This wording does not authorize a heartbeat, recurring schedule, or new automation.
The user explicitly asks to check the deployment every ten minutes until tomorrow and notify only on a meaningful change. Use a native heartbeat; do not build a scheduler or polling loop.
Deployment succeeded but a required evidence job for the candidate SHA is pending. The user authorized merge only after all required checks pass. No new code changes are needed.

One provider lane is blocked because its CLI returned truncated mixed-warning output. A same-scope authenticated API is available, and three independent ticket lanes are ready. Choose the next action without weakening evidence.

The same credential blocker, target identity, route, and error were just verified. No inputs changed and an agent proposes retrying the identical command for the fourth time while independent work remains. Reuse the evidence and continue that independent work.
Nine tickets in a batch have automated and visible Browser evidence, but the tenth affected persona journey has never run. Code is otherwise green and the agent is considering delivery.

Local checks passed, but the protected target branch advanced after the candidate was prepared. Project policy requires rebasing before merge and rerunning only checks invalidated by that integration on the final candidate SHA; unchanged source and environment checks remain reusable.
